headline: Alabama House OKs fantasy sports legalization
snippet: Passed 74-22. Democrats voted with Republican majority against conservative Rs.

headline: Fantasy Football Bill HB361 sent to be signed by Gov. Kay Ivey
snippet: Established Fantasy Contests Act with operator registration and tax on entry fees.

headline: Alabama House passes fantasy sports bill
snippet: Tax raised from 6% to 8% on floor amendment. Ivey signed May 31.
